```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(fishualize)
library(zoo)
```

```{r, echo = F}
#note KD calculated depths every 0.5 m! not every 1 m as I originally thought
# clean and merge together the NS and WE points
NS <- read_csv("NSPoints.csv")
WE <- read_csv("WEPoints.csv")

NS <- NS %>% rename(anchorage = Anchorage_Name)
NS <- NS %>% add_column(Direction = "NS")
NS <- NS %>% mutate(Type = ifelse(grepl("ontrol",anchorage),"Control", "Anchorage"))
NS <- NS %>% mutate(across('anchorage', str_replace, 'control', 'Control'))

WE <- WE %>% rename(anchorage = AnchorageN)
WE <- WE %>% add_column(Direction = "WE")
WE <- WE %>% mutate(Type = ifelse(grepl("ontrol",anchorage),"Control", "Anchorage"))
WE <- WE %>% mutate(across('anchorage', str_replace, 'control', 'Control'))
WE <- WE %>% dplyr::select(anchorage, Latitude, Longitude, X, Y, Depth_m, Type, Direction)

# the profiles need to be sorted by lat and long as there are some weird order issues for a couple of them 

NS <-NS %>% group_by(anchorage) %>% arrange(desc(Latitude), .by_group = TRUE)

WE <- WE %>% group_by(anchorage) %>% arrange(desc(Longitude), .by_group = TRUE)
profiles <- bind_rows(NS, WE)
profiles

# add a main_anchorage column

profiles <-profiles %>% mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("Hou",anchorage), "Houston Pass", anchorage)) %>%
 mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("Nana",anchorage), "Nanaimo",main_anchorage)) %>%
  mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("smith",anchorage), "Ladysmith",main_anchorage)) %>%
     mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("wichan",anchorage), "Cowichan Bay",main_anchorage)) %>%
 mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("Sound",anchorage), "Plumper Sound",main_anchorage)) %>%
  mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("Trin",anchorage), "Trincomali",main_anchorage)) %>%
    mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("Cap",anchorage), "Captain's Pass",main_anchorage)) %>% 
    mutate(main_anchorage = ifelse(grepl("llee",anchorage), "Kulleet Bay",main_anchorage))


profiles

```

# Trincomlai 1-6 change to longer 400 m transects
```{r, echo = F}
# clean and merge together the NS and WE points from the new trincomali transects
NST <- read_csv("NS_long.csv")
WET <- read_csv("WE_long.csv")

NST <- NST %>% rename(anchorage = AnchorageName)
NST <- NST %>% rename(X = UTM10N_X)
NST <- NST %>% rename(Y = UTM10N_Y)
NST <- NST %>% add_column(Direction = "NS")
NST <- NST %>% mutate(Type = ifelse(grepl("ontrol",anchorage),"Control", "Anchorage"))
NST<- NST %>% mutate(across('anchorage', str_replace, 'control', 'Control'))
NST <- NST %>% rename(Depth_m = Trincomali2022_MB_m)

WET <- WET %>% rename(anchorage = AnchorageName)
WET <- WET %>% add_column(Direction = "WE")
WET <- WET %>% mutate(Type = ifelse(grepl("ontrol",anchorage),"Control", "Anchorage"))
WET <- WET %>% mutate(across('anchorage', str_replace, 'control', 'Control'))
WET <- WET %>% rename(Depth_m = Trincomali2022_MB_m)
WET <- WET %>%  mutate(Depth_m = as.numeric(Depth_m))
# the profiles need to be sorted by lat and long as there are some weird order issues for a couple of them 

NST <-NST %>% group_by(anchorage) %>% arrange(desc(Latitude), .by_group = TRUE)

WET <- WET %>% group_by(anchorage) %>% arrange(desc(Longitude), .by_group = TRUE)
profilesTrin <- bind_rows(NST, WET)
profilesTrin


profilesTrin <-profilesTrin %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% mutate(Distance = (id = row_number())) %>% ungroup()

profilesTrin <-profilesTrin %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% mutate(m_from_centre = c(400:0,1:400)) %>% ungroup()
profilesTrin

# add a column called new distance

profilesTrin <-profilesTrin %>% mutate(NewDistance = Distance)
profilesTrin <-profilesTrin %>% mutate(main_anchorage = "Trincomali")

profilesTrin

```

```{r}
anchorages_to_move <- profilesTrin %>%
  pull(anchorage) %>%
  unique()

newprofiles <-profiles %>%
  filter(!anchorage %in% anchorages_to_move)

profiles <- bind_rows(newprofiles, profilesTrin)
```

```{r, echo = F}
#different rolling means
profiles <-profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% mutate(rollingmean20 = rollmean(Depth_m, k=20, fill=NA)) %>% ungroup()

profiles <-profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% mutate(rollingmean40 = rollmean(Depth_m, k=40, fill=NA)) %>% ungroup()

# calculate the difference in raw data from rolling means
profiles <-profiles %>% mutate(diff_depth20 = Depth_m-rollingmean20)
profiles <-profiles %>% mutate(diff_depth30 = Depth_m-rollingmean30)
profiles <-profiles %>% mutate(diff_depth40 = Depth_m-rollingmean40)
profiles <-profiles %>% mutate(diff_depth15 = Depth_m-rollingmean10)
profiles <-profiles %>% mutate(diff_depth5 = Depth_m-rollingmean5)

profiles %>% filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 3") %>% 
  filter(Direction == "NS") %>% 
  ggplot() +
   geom_point(aes(Distance, Depth_m), colour = "grey", cex = 2, show.legend = F) + ylab("Depth (m)") +
  xlim(100,350)

# caluclate area under a bump

df <-profiles %>% filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 1") %>% 
  filter(Direction == "NS") %>% filter(between(NewDistance,250,259)) %>% select(NewDistance, Depth_m, rollingmean30)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    reference =
      first(Depth_m) +
      (last(Depth_m) - first(Depth_m)) *
      ((NewDistance - first(NewDistance)) /
         (last(NewDistance) - first(NewDistance))),

    deviation = reference - Depth_m,

    segment_area =
      (lead(NewDistance) - NewDistance) *
      ((deviation + lead(deviation)) / 2)
  ) 

df %>%
  summarise(
    total_area = sum(segment_area, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

mutate(transect = paste(anchorage, Direction, sep = " "))


#Taking out Ladysmith E and F because they are way too rocky

profiles <- profiles %>% filter(!anchorage %in% c("Ladysmith Anchorage E", "Ladysmith Anchorage F"))
```

# find peaks within the profiles dataframe
https://github.com/stas-g/findPeaks 
```{r, echo= F}

# find peaks for each Anchorage ID
find_peaks <- function (x, m = 3){
    shape <- diff(sign(diff(x, na.pad = FALSE)))
    pks <- sapply(which(shape < 0), FUN = function(i){
       z <- i - m + 1
       z <- ifelse(z > 0, z, 1)
       w <- i + m + 1
       w <- ifelse(w < length(x), w, length(x))
       if(all(x[c(z : i, (i + 2) : w)] <= x[i + 1])) return(i + 1) else return(numeric(0))
    })
     pks <- unlist(pks)
     pks
}

# making a dataset of peaks
peaks <- profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% slice(find_peaks(-Depth_m)) %>% ungroup()
upeaks <-profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% slice(find_peaks(Depth_m)) %>% ungroup()
maxpeaks <- profiles %>% group_by(anchorage, Direction) %>% slice(find_peaks(Depth_m)) %>% ungroup()
trin3 <- peaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 3") %>% filter(Direction == "NS")

trin1 <- peaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 1") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "NS")

trin1up <- upeaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 1") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "NS")

trin1a <- maxpeaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 1") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "NS")

#thinking about limiting somehow to troughs of a certain width...can we use the peaks to determine that?
trin1a %>% dplyr::select(Depth_m, Distance) %>% mutate(dist_diff = Distance - lag(Distance)) %>% print(n = Inf)

houston <- peaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Houston Pass Anchorage 1") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "NS")
houstonup <- upeaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Houston Pass Anchorage 1") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "NS")

xlady4 <-peaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Xladysmith Anchorage 4") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "WE")
xlady4up <-upeaks %>% dplyr::filter(anchorage == "Xladysmith Anchorage 4") %>% dplyr::filter(Direction == "WE")
```

# MESSING AROUND TO TRY AND GET TOTAL TROUGH OR SCOUR DEPTH FROM PEAK TO TROUGH

```{r = echo = F}

combined <- bind_rows(
  peaks %>% mutate(feature = "trough"),
  upeaks %>% mutate(feature = "peak")) %>% arrange(anchorage, Direction, Distance, NewDistance)

combined


# add peak before
combined <-combined %>%
  mutate(
    peak_before = if_else(feature == "peak", Depth_m, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  fill(peak_before, .direction = "down")

#add peak after
combined <-combined %>%
  mutate(
    peak_after = if_else(feature == "peak", Depth_m, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  fill(peak_after, .direction = "up")

combined <- combined %>% mutate(avg_peak = ((peak_before+peak_after)/2))

# Keep troughs and calculate distances
trough_totdepth <- combined %>%
  filter(feature == "trough") %>%
  mutate(
    depth_to_peak_before = peak_before - Depth_m,
    depth_to_peak_after  = peak_after - Depth_m,
    depth_to_avg_peak = avg_peak - Depth_m,
    smallest_peak_depth = pmin(depth_to_peak_before, depth_to_peak_after, na.rm = TRUE))


trough_totdepth %>% dplyr::select(anchorage, Direction, Distance, NewDistance, Depth_m, peak_before,peak_after, avg_peak, diff_depth30, smallest_peak_depth, depth_to_avg_peak) %>% filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 1") %>% filter(between(Distance,200,250))

trough_totdepth_select <-trough_totdepth %>% dplyr::select(anchorage, Direction, Distance, NewDistance, rollingmean30, Depth_m, peak_before,peak_after, diff_depth30, depth_to_avg_peak, smallest_peak_depth)

trough_totdepth_select %>% dplyr::filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% filter(smallest_peak_depth >0.5)
trough_totdepth_select %>% dplyr::filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% filter(diff_depth30 <(-0.5))

trough_totdepth_select %>% dplyr::filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% mutate(trough_torolling = -1*diff_depth30) %>% mutate(ratio = 1-(trough_torolling/smallest_peak_depth)) %>%
  summarise(across(
    c(trough_torolling, depth_to_avg_peak, smallest_peak_depth),
    list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
         sd   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ))

trough_totdepth_select %>% dplyr::filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% mutate(trough_torolling = -1*diff_depth30)  %>% print(n = 200)


trough_totdepth_select %>% dplyr::filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% filter(between(depth_to_avg_peak,0.8,2)) %>% print(n = Inf)


trough_totdepth_select %>% dplyr::filter(diff_depth30 <(-0.5))

# let's look at Xladysmith anchorage4

profiles %>% filter(anchorage == "Xladysmith Anchorage 4") %>% 
  filter(Direction == "WE") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(NewDistance,Depth_m),colour = "grey20", show.legend = T) +

  geom_point(data = xlady4up, aes(NewDistance, Depth_m,), colour = "#de2d26", cex = 2.5, show.legend = T) +

     xlim(0,100)  +

# use this: avg peak for all deviations greater that 0.1 m into sediment, then take ratio of diff to rolling30 mean and avg peak (0.171/033 = 0.52 x bigger for avg peak)
trough_totdepth_select %>% filter(diff_depth30 <(-0.1)) %>% filter(depth_to_avg_peak <10) %>% summarise(across(
    c(diff_depth30, depth_to_avg_peak, smallest_peak_depth),
    list(mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
         sd   = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ))

# 561 deeper than 0.1, 122 deeper than 0.2, 8 over 0.5 with the deepest being 0.8 at a ladysmith anchorage
  
trough_compare_trin <-trough_totdepth_select %>% filter(anchorage == "Trincomali Anchorage 1") %>% filter(!depth_to_avg_peak >10) %>% mutate(trough_torolling = -1*diff_depth30) %>% mutate(ratio = (trough_torolling/depth_to_avg_peak))

summary(trough_compare_trin)

trough_compare_trin %>% filter(!diff_depth30 >0) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(Distance,-diff_depth30),colour = "grey20", show.legend = T) +
   geom_point(aes(Distance, depth_to_avg_peak), colour = "pink", cex = 1, show.legend = F) +
```

# sdmTMB model set up - making mesh, coords etc
```{r, echo = F}

library(sdmTMB)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)

peaks <-peaks %>% rename(Xm = X, Ym = Y)
get_crs(peaks, c("Longitude", "Latitude")) #function from sdmTMB to check coordinates crs


peaks <- add_utm_columns(peaks, c("Longitude", "Latitude"))

peaks <- peaks %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

peaks %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(diff_depth30), bins = 80) +
  xlim(-0.5, 0.25)

neg_peaks <-peaks %>% filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% mutate(deviations = abs(diff_depth30))

neg_peaks %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(deviations), bins = 80) +
  xlim(-0.5, 0.25)


#scale predictors
preds <- dplyr::select(neg_peaks, 
                       total_events,
                       total_events_premulti,
                       total_time,
                       total_time_premulti,
                       years_used,
                       last_used,
                       m_from_centre, 
                      )
peaks_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(preds, center = T, scale = T))
names(peaks_scaled) <- paste0(names(peaks_scaled), "_scaled")
peaks_scaled <- cbind(peaks_scaled,
                      neg_peaks)

peaks_scaled %>%  filter(is.na(total_time_premulti_scaled))

peaks_scaled <-peaks_scaled %>%  mutate(id = as.factor(main_anchorage.x)) %>% mutate(id = as.factor(anchorage)) 

mesh <- make_mesh(data = peaks_scaled, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 1) #the cutoff is in km

plot(mesh)


```

```{r, echo =F}
peak_m1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled, mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m1.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled, mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m2 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + (1|main_anchorage.x), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m2.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + (1|main_anchorage.x), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m3 <-sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m3.1 <-sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = lognormal(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m4 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|main_anchorage.x), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m4.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|main_anchorage.x), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m5 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m5.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type + m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))


peak_m6 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type*m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m6.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type*m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m7 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type*m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled*m_from_centre_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "on", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

peak_m7.1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~ Type*m_from_centre_scaled + total_time_premulti_scaled*m_from_centre_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = peaks_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

AIC(peak_m1,peak_m1.1, peak_m2, peak_m2.1, peak_m3,peak_m3.1, peak_m4, peak_m4.1, peak_m5, peak_m5.1, peak_m6, peak_m6.1, peak_m7, peak_m7.1)


summary(peak_m8)
summary(peak_m6)


#checking simulation based randomized quantile residuals using DHARMa, KS test is significant but it looks fine and I think it is because there is a big sample size https://github.com/florianhartig/DHARMa/issues/181
set.seed(123)
s <- simulate(peak_m6, nsim = 500, type = "mle-mvn")
dharma_residuals(s, peak_m6)

peaks_scaled$resid <- residuals(peak_m6)
qqnorm(peaks_scaled$resid)

qqline(peaks_scaled$resid)

visreg::visreg(peak_m6, "m_from_centre_scaled", scale = "response")
visreg::visreg(peak_m6, "total_time_premulti_scaled", scale = "response")
```

# for new Figure 7 distance plot (plot only this with the interaction term)
```{r}

#The package ggeffects can be used to plot marginal effects of given predictor variables in sdmTMB models.

#A advantage to this approach over visreg, is that ggeffects calculates marginal effects with the effects package using the parameter covariance matrix. This is nearly instant compared to visreg, which has to calculate conditional effects by calculating predictions with TMB.

#A disadvantage to using ggeffects is that it will only work for regular linear effects in the main model formula. I.e., it will not work with smoothers (internally these are random effects) or breakpoint (breakpt()) effects.

#Another important distinction is that ggeffects::ggeffect() is plotting marginal effects. This means the effects are “marginalized” or “averaged” over the other fixed effects. visreg::visreg() is plotting conditional effects. This means they are conditional on the other predictors being set to certain values. ggeffects::ggpredict() also does conditional effects, but this has not yet been set up in sdmTMB using the CRAN version of ggeffects.
predict_final <- ggeffect(peak_m6, terms = c("m_from_centre_scaled", "Type")) %>%  
  rename(m_from_centre_scaled = x)

predict_final <-as_tibble(predict_final)
predict_final
#un center and unscale the predictions
predict_final <-predict_final %>% mutate(m_from_centre = m_from_centre_scaled*sd(peaks_scaled$m_from_centre)+
             mean(peaks_scaled$m_from_centre))

  ggplot(peaks_scaled, aes(x = m_from_centre, y = -deviations, colour = Type)) +
  #plot the raw data
  geom_point(aes(colour = Type), alpha = 0.4) +
  #now plot the  model output
  geom_ribbon(data = predict_final,
              aes(y = -predicted, ymin = -conf.low, ymax = -conf.high,
                  colour = group, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = predict_final,
            aes(y = -predicted, colour = group)) +
    ylab("Sediment disturbance depth (m)") +
    xlab("Distance from anchroage centre (m)") +
    ylim(-1,0) +
  theme_classic()
```

# UPDATED FIGURE 7
```{r}
p_depth <-ggplot(peaks_scaled, aes(x = m_from_centre, y = -deviations)) +

  # --- RAW DATA FIRST (so it's behind everything) ---
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Type),
    size = 1.6,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # --- MODEL LAYERS ON TOP ---

  # grey confidence ribbons
  geom_ribbon(
    data = predict_final,
    aes(
      x = m_from_centre,
      ymin = -conf.low,
      ymax = -conf.high,
      group = group
    ),
    fill = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.65,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # model prediction lines (coloured by Type)
  geom_line(
    data = predict_final,
    aes(
      x = m_from_centre,
      y = -predicted,
      colour = group,
      group = group
    ),
    linewidth = 1.3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # --- SCALES ---

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Anchorage" = "#1b9e77",
      "Control"   = "#d95f02"
    ),
    name = " Site type",
    breaks = c("Anchorage", "Control"),
                labels = c("Anchorage", "Reference"), # ensures both appear in legend
  ) +

  # --- AXES ---

  #controls how far data is from axes (have set x distance to zero in this case)
scale_x_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.05))
) +

coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, max(peaks_scaled$m_from_centre, na.rm = TRUE)),
  ylim = c(-0.5, 0)
) +

  labs(
    x = "Distance From Centre (m)",
    y = "Sediment disturbance depth (m)"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "depth_distance_interaction.png",
  plot = p_depth,
  width = 8,       # inches
  height = 4.5,    # inches
  dpi = 600
)

```

```{r, echo = F}
predict_final <-predict_final %>% mutate(total_time_premulti = total_time_premulti_scaled*sd(peaks_scaled$total_time_premulti)+
             mean(peaks_scaled$total_time_premulti))

  ggplot(peaks_scaled, aes(x = total_time_premulti, y = -deviations)) +
  #plot the raw data
  geom_point(aes(), colour = "grey50", alpha = 0.4) +
  #now plot the  model output
  geom_ribbon(data = predict_final,
              aes(y = -predicted, ymin = -conf.low, ymax = -conf.high),
                  fill = "blue", 
              alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = predict_final,
            aes(y = -predicted), colour = "blue") +
    ylab("Sediment disturbance depth (m)") +

    ylim(-1.75, 0) +
  theme_classic()
```

# Experimenting with only looking at anchorages and only within 50 m of centre

# sdmTMB model set up - making mesh, coords etc
```{r, echo = F}


peaks <-peaks %>% rename(Xm = X, Ym = Y)
get_crs(peaks, c("Longitude", "Latitude")) #function from sdmTMB to check coordinates crs


peaks <- add_utm_columns(peaks, c("Longitude", "Latitude"))

peaks <- peaks %>% mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

peaks %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(diff_depth30), bins = 80) +
  xlim(-0.5, 0.25)

neg_peaks <-peaks %>% filter(diff_depth30 <0) %>% mutate(deviations = abs(diff_depth30))

neg_peaks %>% ggplot() + geom_histogram(aes(deviations), bins = 80) +
  xlim(-0.5, 0.25)

anchor_only <- neg_peaks %>% filter(Type == "Anchorage") %>% filter(m_from_centre <51)

anchor_only <- anchor_only %>%
  mutate(
    time_bin = factor(
      ntile(total_time_premulti, 4),
      labels = c("Low", "Medium-Low", "Medium-High", "High")
    )
  )
#scale predictors
preds <- dplyr::select(anchor_only, 
                       total_events,
                       total_events_premulti,
                       total_time,
                       total_time_premulti,
                       years_used,
                       last_used,
                       m_from_centre
                      )
anchor_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(preds, center = T, scale = T))
names(anchor_scaled) <- paste0(names(anchor_scaled), "_scaled")
anchor_scaled <- cbind(anchor_scaled,
                      anchor_only)


anchor_scaled <-anchor_scaled %>%  mutate(id = as.factor(main_anchorage.x)) %>% mutate(id = as.factor(anchorage)) 

mesh <- make_mesh(data = anchor_scaled, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 1) #the cutoff is in km

plot(mesh)




m1 <- sdmTMB(formula = deviations ~  total_time_premulti_scaled + (1|anchorage), mesh = mesh, spatial = "off", family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = anchor_scaled, control = sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 5))

sanity(m1)


predict_final <- ggeffect(m1, terms = c("total_time_premulti_scaled")) %>%  
  rename(total_time_scaled = x)

predict_final <-as_tibble(predict_final)
predict_final
#un center and unscale the predictions
predict_final <-predict_final %>% mutate(total_time = total_time_scaled*sd(peaks_scaled$total_time_premulti)+
             mean(peaks_scaled$total_time_premulti))


predict_final <-as_tibble(predict_final)
predict_final


  ggplot(anchor_scaled,
                  aes(x = total_time,
                      y = -deviations)) +
    
    geom_point(
    aes(colour = anchorage),
    size = 1.6,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  # MODEL LINES
  geom_line(
    data = predict_final,
    aes(
      x = total_time,
      y = -predicted,
    ),
    linewidth = 1.3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +


  labs(
    x = "Total anchoring time (hrs)",
    y = "Sediment disturbance depth (m)"
  
    ) +
theme(
  legend.position = "none"
)
  
  
# remember that variables are scaled and in log space so you can exponentiate and then look at % change (exp(coeff)-1) 
# 
# real space value of 1 SD time
sd(anchor_scaled$total_time_premulti, na.rm = TRUE)


m1 # model with interation and spatial on

#confidence intervals instead of SE for reporting % change
confint(m1, level = 0.95)

# thinking about p vals from https://github.com/sdmTMB/sdmTMB/discussions/360
summary(m1$sd_report, p.value=TRUE)

# 20% per SD (SD is 7374.754 hours)
(exp(0.1851209)-1)
```
